title: Vibrant Savory Jamaican Pasta
description: A savory and kid-friendly Jamaican dish featuring onions and al-dente pasta, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is ovo-vegetarian friendly and has a salty, aerated flavor.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al-dente.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the jamaican seasoning, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
In a small bowl, beat the egg and set aside.
When the pasta is done cooking, drain it and add it to the skillet with the onion and garlic mixture.
Toss the pasta to combine with the onion and garlic mixture, then stir in the beaten egg.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the egg is cooked through and the pasta is well coated.
If using cheese, stir it in until melted and well combined.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
